blocNotes: Lines covered: non-alcoholic beverages (2202), beer, wine (2204.10, 2204.21), spirits (2208), tobacco products (2402), motor spirit, kerosene and gas oils, medicaments (3004.90), cotton T-shirts, smartphones, cars of 1 500-3 000 cm3; any other code is grade C. Rice (1006.30) is a Schedule 2 sensitive item at '75% or $345/MT' (a US$ specific alternative with no rate of exchange in the rule): grade C.
An imported line with no origin pays the CET (the model's convention); an EAC origin (KE UG TZ RW BI SS) pays nothing.
The customs value is the price before VAT and duty; where an excise is also inside the price the line should give customsValue.
